inputs.52.text: Modern flat-colour anime illustration in the style of a cute mobile-game mascot key visual: bold, clean dark outlines of even weight, bright flat cel colours filled edge to edge, one simple step of soft lavender shading, crisp edges everywhere. A school auditorium darkened for a film screening, seen from the back of the room at seated eye height. Rows of theatre seats fill the lower half of the picture, the backs of the audience's heads as soft, smooth dark violet silhouettes, seen only from behind. At the front, a large projection screen fills the upper middle of the picture, glowing a soft blank warm white, the only light in the room. The light from the screen spills over the tops of the seats and the silhouettes' hair in a pale rim. Dark navy and deep violet walls fading into shadow at the sides. Deep navy, violet and warm white.
